perfil: Nobody would expect a Xuan Shi to be so timid. Her giant writing brush is a modified flamethrower and also her instrument in drawing powerful talismans.

habilidades.b: Hurls the writing brush to perform multiple attacks.

tpl.s: Waves the writing brush and inflicts Ink. Strike 1: ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Ignis Auto Attack DMG. Strike 2: ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Ignis Auto Attack DMG. Strike 3: ⟦2⟧ of ATK as Ignis Auto Attack DMG. Strike 4: ⟦3⟧ of ATK as Ignis Auto Attack DMG. Strike 5: ⟦4⟧ of ATK as Ignis Auto Attack DMG.

habilidades.b: Spreads out a torrent of flames ahead, dealing DMG over time. The Main Skill can trigger ⟨Ignis Mark⟩ and inflict Incineration.

tpl.s: Spreads out a torrent of flames, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Skill DMG every 0.2s for a total of 3s. When dealing DMG to targets with Ink, inflicts ⟨Ignite⟩. Purifying Flames (Main Skill) can trigger ⟨Ignis Mark⟩ and inflict Incineration, dealing ⟪0⟫ of ATK as AoE Ignis Mark DMG.

habilidades.b: Summons a ⟨Crimson Dragon⟩ to attack the target. ⟨Crimson Dragon⟩'s DMG can inflict ⟨Ignis Mark: Sacred Flame⟩.

tpl.s: Summons a ⟨Crimson Dragon⟩ every 2s, up to 3 times. ⟨Crimson Dragon⟩ spits Ink at the target, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Ignis Minion's DMG. Upon vanishing, it charges toward the target, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Ignis Minion's AoE DMG. When ⟨Crimson Dragon⟩ deals DMG, inflicts ⟨Ignis Mark: Sacred Flame⟩. Minions summoned by Awakening: Crimson Dragon will be removed when the Support Skill is cast again.

habilidades.b: Conjures a Fire Dragon to attack the target's location.

tpl.s: Conjures a Fire Dragon to circle around the target, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Ignis Ultimate DMG in a large area every 0.3s for a total of 5s.

builds.d: A build that extends the duration of flames and enhances Auto Attacks when there is enough heat.
A DPS build that boosts the burst DMG of flames.

l.b: Increases the Main Skill's duration and DMG.
l.s: Increases the duration of Purifying Flames (Main Skill) by ⟦0⟧s and Skill DMG by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: When Chixia unleashes flames with the Main Skill, builds up heat. Once full, enhances her Auto Attacks.
l.s: When casting Purifying Flames (Main Skill), generates 1 stack of heat every second. Once full, enhances Chixia's Auto Attacks, dealing ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Auto Attack DMG. Each enhanced Auto Attack consumes 1 stack of heat. When an enhanced Auto Attack deals DMG to targets with Ink, inflicts ⟨Ignite⟩.

l.b: When a target inflicted with ⟨Ignite⟩ is killed, leaves behind lingering flames that deal DOT.
l.s: When a target inflicted with ⟨Ignite⟩ is killed, leaves behind lingering flames, dealing ⟦0⟧ as AoE Ignis Skill DMG per second for a total of 8s.

l.b: Reduces the ATK of targets inflicted with ⟨Ignite⟩.
l.s: Reduces the ATK of targets inflicted with ⟨Ignite⟩ by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: While the Main Skill is active, increases the squad's ATK.
l.s: While Purifying Flames (Main Skill) is active, increases the squad's ATK by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Ink can stack on targets. Once fully stacked, triggers ⟨Ignite⟩, dealing additional DMG.
l.s: Ink can stack up to ⟦0⟧ times on targets. When a target with 4 stacks of Ink triggers ⟨Ignite⟩, deals ⟦1⟧ as AoE Ignis Skill DMG.

l.b: Increases the DMG and Attack Range of the Main Skill.
l.s: Increases the Attack Range of Purifying Flames (Main Skill).  Increases Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧. This effect gradually diminishes over 3s.

l.b: The Main Skill deals additional damage. When the Main Skill inflicts ⟨Ignite⟩ on targets, increases the Ignis DMG they take.
l.s: When casting Purifying Flames (Main Skill), deals an additional ⟦0⟧ as AoE Ignis Skill DMG and inflicts Ink. When the Main Skill inflicts ⟨Ignite⟩ on targets inflicted with Ink, increases the Ignis DMG they take by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: Ink can increase the Ignis DMG taken by the target.
l.s: For each stack of Ink on the target, increases the Ignis DMG taken by the target by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Casting the Main Skill grants a Shield and Super Armor while the Shield lasts.
l.s: Casting Purifying Flames (Main Skill) grants a Shield equal to ⟦0⟧ of Max HP and Super Armor while the Shield lasts.

l.b: Chixia can dodge one more time. When casting the Main Skill, increases ATK.
l.s: Can dodge one more time.  When casting Purifying Flames (Main Skill), increases ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 3s. While the Main Skill is active, each Crit Hit increases the skill's duration by 1s, up to a total of 3s.

l.b: The Ultimate can trigger ⟨Ignis Mark⟩ and inflict Incineration. Each time the mark is triggered, increases Chixia's ATK.
l.s: Dragon's Ascension (Ultimate) can trigger ⟨Ignis Mark⟩ and inflict Incineration, dealing 28%/36%/45%/53%/61%/70% of ATK as AoE Ignis Mark DMG. Each time the mark is triggered, increases Chixia's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 10s, up to 5 stacks.

l.b: When Chixia triggers ⟨Ignis Mark⟩, increases the Ignis DMG taken by the target.
l.s: When Chixia triggers ⟨Ignis Mark⟩, increases the Ignis DMG taken by the target by ⟦0⟧ for 10s, stacking up to 3 times.

l.b: When the Ultimate lands a Crit Hit, increases Chixia's ATK.
l.s: When Dragon's Ascension (Ultimate) lands a Crit Hit, increases Chixia's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 10s, up to 5 stacks.

l.b: The Ultimate creates a blaze vortex that deals DMG over time.
l.s: When casting Dragon's Ascension, creates a blaze vortex, dealing ⟦0⟧ as AoE Ignis Ultimate DMG every 0.5s for a total of 8s.

l.b: When the Ultimate ends, the main Trekker continuously deals DMG in front.
l.s: When Dragon's Ascension ends, the mighty dragon possesses the main Trekker, dealing ⟦0⟧ as AoE Ignis Ultimate DMG every 2s for a total of 8s.
